segments.comment: Independent wizard-mode death by eating a wished-for cockatrice corpse on a new level 3, answering yes to Save bones. Stoning sets u.ugrave_arise to LEAVESTATUE, so bones.c savebones() makes a statue of the hero (mkobj.c mk_named_object()) and drop_upon_death() puts the possessions, including the partly eaten corpse, inside it (mkobj.c add_to_container()). A second game on a new seed and clock goes to level 3 and loads that bones file (bones.c getbones()), so the statue and its contents round-trip. The seeds, clocks, character, and input were chosen for this path.
